notes.title: Demo Build v2 - Released
notes.content: Good news everyone! A new build has been released which fixes the game breaking boss battle bug and a few sound optimizations. We plan to make another build soon with more bug fixes and optimizations.

notes.title: Bug Notice: Boss Fight
notes.content: We have been informed of a bug that can break the finale, we are working on a fix, in the meantime, you can avoid the bug by not standing too close to the boss. Sorry for any inconvenience, thanks for your understanding and support.
